summary.intent: Land a batch of Caliper PRs (Chakra NonNullable, React builtins, module augmentation, weekly harness, Pick/union) with clean Entire trail organization, then resolve the merge conflict on feat/collapsed-layer-members after main absorbed other work.
summary.outcome: Five PRs (#272-#276) were opened as drafts and linked to trails, though #270 and #271 could not be reparented and Entire auto-created duplicate PRs #277/#278. The user merged builtins, augmentation and Pick/union into main, and the collapsed-layer-members branch had main merged in, with one conflict and one silent missing-field site fixed in resolver/chain.rs, and a signed merge commit created.

repo: CI-equivalent gate is: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; CI=1 CALIPER_TEST_TSC=<worktree>/apps/oracle/node_modules/typescript-beta/bin/tsc cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --no-fail-fast; then just lint doc-check typos machete. Running only a subset of crates previously broke #271.

Main requires signed commits; in agent environments `git log %G?` prints E (unverifiable key) even though the commit has a valid gpgsig block, so check with git cat-file or %GK rather than using --no-gpg-sign.
Branch names checked out in other worktrees cannot be reused, so agents worked on local branches (e.g. fix/chakra-nonnullable-fix) and pushed fast-forward to the real remote branch.
Scripts/CI-only PRs in this repo do not need a changeset; the Changesets job only runs a status check and release dry-run.

Adding a field to InheritedLayer (members) requires updating every struct literal; a literal added on main merged without conflict but failed compilation, so always rebuild the full workspace after merging main.
just bench compares head vs base on mantine and chakra corpora with limits of 1.10x time and 1.20x RSS; it is only needed for resolver changes.

code.finding: Merge conflict was in total_props for the HTML inherited layer: keep main's expression and add members: vec![] since that layer is not a collapsed source. A second InheritedLayer literal added by main elsewhere in this file also needed members.

workflow: The gh shim covers only `gh pr create` and fails closed when Touch ID/key is unavailable (OSStatus -25308); batching PR creation under one approval avoids expiry between PRs.

Entire trails: a branch can belong to only one trail; `trail link` returns 409 for already-owned changes, `unlink` refuses to detach, and the CLI has no reparent or delete (only `update --status closed`).
Opening a PR before linking makes Entire auto-create a duplicate trail; linking stacked branches makes Entire open its own draft PR against main, producing duplicates (#277/#278).

Preferred flow from another session: create the trail first (intent-only), push branches, link with --base main so Entire opens the PR, then edit its title/body while keeping the entire-shadow-pr marker; merge via trail approval in the Entire UI.
User preference: plan feature-focused trails and assign branches to them before creating anything; saved as memory plan-trails-before-branches.
Stacked PRs should state parent and merge order in the body, merge bottom-up, then retarget children to main and merge main in.

friction: Touch ID approval expired mid-batch, blocking the first attempt to open PRs.
Entire auto-created duplicate trail #134 and duplicate PRs #277/#278, and the CLI could not reparent or delete trails, so #270 and #271 stayed in non-ideal trails.
Replacing Entire-opened PR bodies dropped the entire-shadow-pr marker.
Agents' signature check printed E instead of G, needing manual verification.
Chakra NonNullable fix was not re-measured on a Chakra corpus with dependencies loaded after the review fixes.
Merging main into the branch produced a hidden compile failure from a new InheritedLayer literal that git did not flag.
open_items: Merge #271 then #275, retarget #275 to main and merge main in; weekly workflow re-run against baseline on trail 125, then update docs/STATUS.md and site numbers.
Push the signed merge commit on feat/collapsed-layer-members and watch CI.

Proposed new trails A-D (object-literal/call-result components, import-source matching and alias-variant audit, key policy awaiting user decision, PR-batch script and just ci equals CI check) await plan approval.
Verify whether just ci matches the CI jobs exactly and point AGENTS.md at it.
#275's Linux RSS fix is inferred and unproven; its recall denominator change may trip the 2-point weekly notice.
Trails 134, 125 and 140 are left uncleaned; #271 sits in 125 and #270 in 134 rather than the intended groupings.
